description: This PHP source file defines the Doctrine ORM entity class 'OAuthAuthorizationCode' within the OrangeHRM project. The class models an OAuth 2.0 authorization code record, including properties such as code, client ID, user ID, redirect URI, expiry time, and revoked status. It maps these properties to the 'ohrm_oauth2_authorization_code' database table and provides getter/setter methods for each.

classes.name: OAuthAuthorizationCode
classes.description: An entity class representing an OAuth authorization code, including properties for authorization code details and methods for property access and modification.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the authorization code record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the authorization code record.

methods.name: getClientId
methods.description: Returns the client ID associated with this authorization code.

methods.name: setClientId
methods.description: Sets the client ID associated with this authorization code.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Returns the user ID associated with this authorization code.

methods.name: setUserId
methods.description: Sets the user ID associated with this authorization code.

methods.name: getRedirectUri
methods.description: Returns the redirect URI associated with this authorization code.

methods.name: setRedirectUri
methods.description: Sets the redirect URI for this authorization code.

methods.name: getExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Returns the expiry date and time in UTC as a DateTimeImmutable object.

methods.name: setExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Sets the expiry date and time for the authorization code.

methods.name: isRevoked
methods.description: Returns whether the authorization code has been revoked.

methods.name: setRevoked
methods.description: Sets the revoked status of the authorization code.
